newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's assigns Aa2 rating to TCNZ Finance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's assigns Aa2 rating to TCNZ Finance.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned an Aa2 long-term debt rating to TCNZ Finance Ltd's NZ$275 million capital notes issue.
Moody's said the rating reflected the unsecured and subordinated status of the notes, which will be ranked after all TCNZ Finance Ltd's new and existing senior, Aa1-rated debt.
It also reflected the company's position as a wholly owned and controlled subsidiary of Telecom Corp of New Zealand (Telecom) Ltd, the ratings agency said.

"The support for the capital notes differs from previous TCNZ Finance Ltd issues which have benefited from a direct guarantee from Telecom Corporation of New Zealand Ltd and its material subsidiaries," Moody's said.
Moody's said it did not believe TCNZ Finance would change its primary function as a "finance conduit" for New Zealand Telecom, the main supplier of telecommunication services in New Zealand.
